field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Lets an AI agent platform pay for an order with a Stripe Shared Payment Token (spt_…) passed as the Stripe payment method. When off, an order carrying one is refused before anything is charged. Requires Agentic Commerce to be enabled on the Stripe account.

field.label: Stripe API version for token payments
field.comment: Stripe-Version used only while confirming a payment made with a shared payment token (they are a preview API). Every other Stripe call keeps the Stripe module's own version.
